req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-026 requires HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. The endpoint supports GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH, HEAD (as a method-check), OPTIONS (framework-dependent). Tests cover: (1) positive — supported method GET returns 200, confirming the endpoint is live and method-routing works; (2) negative — POST to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405; (3) boundary — PATCH to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405 (PATCH is adjacent to PUT, a common mutation target); (4) additional negative — multiple unsupported methods each return exactly 405, not 404 or 400, catching constant-mutation on the status code. Exact status code assertions (== 405, == 200) kill off-by-one and comparison-flip mutations.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_get_supported_method_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 1
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert body["completed"] == True

tests.name: test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405
preconditions: App is initialised in-process with TestClient
Task with id=3 exists in the pre-loaded dataset
trace: R-TASK-026: decision table — all unsupported methods map to 405; catches constant mutation 405->404 or 405->400
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405():
    client = TestClient(app)
    unsupported = [
        client.post("/tasks/3", json={"title": "T", "completed": False}),
        client.patch("/tasks/3", json={"title": "T"}),
    ]
    for r in unsupported:
        assert r.status_code == 405
        assert r.status_code != 404
        assert r.status_code != 400
        assert r.status_code != 200

test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405()
